definition: A competition mathematics set used across three sources as the harder rung of an evaluation suite, alongside the AIME sets and easier benchmarks. Its role in this archive is as a small, hard set where differences are large in points and weak in evidence: the privileged-distillation work reports it among three thirty-problem competition sets whose macro average carries a 5.617-point gain with a bootstrap interval spanning 2.592 to 8.333, and the unsupervised self-distillation work reports the full-vocabulary objective leading by 7.2 percent on it under pseudo-labels against 2.7 under gold supervision. The verifier-free selection work uses it as one of three benchmarks where confidence-maximisation selectors drop below the base pass rate, falling 76.5 to 68.0 on one model. None of the sources describes its construction; what the archive should carry is that a handful of problems separates methods here, so intervals matter more than point estimates.

evidence.note: Removes external supervision from on-policy self-distillation by building a pseudo-solution from the model's own majority vote and using it as privileged teacher context rather than as a scalar reward, then distilling only on the completions that disagree with it.
evidence.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation without Any Supervision

evidence.note: Gives the teacher in on-policy self-distillation access to each completed student rollout and its verified outcome, adapting it to preserve behaviour on successes and redirect failures toward verified success, while the student keeps a prefix-only interface it can actually deploy.
evidence.title: PAST: Privileged Adaptation from Complete Student Trajectories for On-Policy Self-Distillation

evidence.note: Shows that selecting the most confident rollout can be worse than picking at random, because uniformly high confidence signals a failure to explore rather than a well-supported answer, and replaces maximisation with a temporal criterion that penalises early certainty while requiring late certainty.
evidence.title: Consilience for Verifier-Free Test-Time Scaling
